cards.title: Join the Southern Arrival
instructions: Establish 1 WTD northbound at 1,000' MSL · 240 KIAS
Turn direct to Point Shamrock between Twin Condos and Port Royal
Be alert for traffic already established on the Southern Arrival at 1,000' MSL
